newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Long takes outright Johnnie Walker Classic lead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Long takes outright Johnnie Walker Classic lead.

text.p: New Zealand golfer Michael Long led the Johnnie Walker Classic by two strokes on Friday after completing his second round in four-under-par 68.
Long had been four-under and one behind the leaders overnight but surged to an eight-under total to lead by two strokes from Ernie Els of South Africa.
Els also carded a second round 68 after being two-under overnight.
Long set up his lead with an eagle at the 17th hole and then a birdie at the 18th.

Two players -- Jean Van Der Velde of France and England's Paul Eales -- were in the clubhouse on five-under while U.S. golfer Fred Couples had also picked up a shot on his overnight score to be five-under after two holes.

England's Nick Faldo was another three shots back on two-under after an even-par second round of 72. Colin Montgomerie of Scotland and Germany's Bernhard Langer were both one-over at the end of their second rounds.
